name: RepurposeIQ: one source to 7 reviewed drafts

parameters.formDescription: Paste a published Substack post. RepurposeIQ pulls the text, drafts 7 channel formats from the exact source sentences, checks every number against the source, then hands the drafts to a human editor for review. No AI model is used.

values.placeholder: Optional. Defaults to the source URL
